key_insight: GDGraph converts radiology guidelines into executable decision graphs, raising case-evaluation accuracy from 57.3% to 90.8% in the reported study.
clinical_relevance: The framework could support more traceable guideline-based risk stratification and management planning in medical imaging.
method: An LLM partitions guidelines into sections and extracts decision subgraphs with linked definitions.
Related branches are compiled into an executable decision graph.
A fast model answers localized case questions while deterministic traversal resolves Boolean logic.
evidence_signal: Across 347 renal cyst, adnexal mass, and thyroid nodule cases, GDGraph achieved 90.8% accuracy versus 80.1% for retrieval-augmented GPT-4o and 82.7% for graph-guided GPT-4o with chain-of-thought, with lower reported latency and cost.
watch_item: The abstract does not report prospective clinical validation; guideline-compilation errors and real-world reliability require further evaluation.
paper_title: Radiology Guideline-derived Decision Graph for Efficient Clinical Decision Support
